# State Management Checklist: Product Line B Onboarding Smoke

**Purpose**: Validate disabled-by-default lifecycle, explicit enable/disable semantics, sync/dispatch pause requirements, and inactive Product Line B visibility before tasks.
**Created**: 2026-06-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are disabled-by-default requirements defined for both seed/apply state and final post-smoke state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Are exact Product Line B smoke-owned flags and pause evidence fields enumerated so implementation can distinguish disabled, enabled-for-smoke, and clean-disabled states? [Resolved, Spec §FR-012, Plan §State Management Contract]
- [ ] CHK003 Are Product Line B repo sync-owner and GitHub sync-disabled requirements defined independently from synthetic repo metadata? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Are required state transitions documented from absent to disabled seed, smoke enabled, smoke recorded, and disabled clean? [Completeness, Data Model §ProductLineBLifecycleState]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is `disabled_at` clearly scoped as supporting lifecycle evidence rather than a universal access guard? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK006 Is explicit enablement defined narrowly enough to make exactly one synthetic Product Line B smoke item eligible while leaving general sync/dispatch paused? [Resolved, Spec §FR-007, Plan §State Management Contract]
- [ ] CHK007 Is inactive Product Line B visibility clearly split between normal switcher absence and inspectable SQL/API/seed/evidence paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do seed CLI mode requirements remain consistent with the decision not to add `enable` or `disable` seed modes? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Modes]
- [ ] CHK009 Are Product Line B workspace feature-flag requirements consistent between the spec, data model, seed CLI contract, and smoke evidence contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §ProductLineBSeedConfig, Contract §Cleanup Counters]
- [ ] CHK010 Are runtime-inventory requirements consistently described as optional read-only support and not as a lifecycle eligibility gate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can clean disablement be objectively measured through non-null disabled state, absent/false flags, no repo sync owner rows, and zero eligible smoke work? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Can Product Line A isolation be objectively measured without treating expected Product Line B rows as drift? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Contract §SQL Evidence]
- [ ] CHK013 Are timing requirements measurable without making optional live GitHub UAT a required gate? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are disabled seed, explicit enable, smoke, disable, cleanup, and verify scenarios all covered as separate state phases? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK015 Are failure and recovery requirements defined for residue, Product Line A isolation violation, incomplete disablement, and cleanup failure? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Are inactive Product Line B dashboard visibility states covered after seed/apply, during smoke enablement, and after final disablement? [Coverage, Contract §Switcher Evidence]

## Dependencies And Assumptions
